cohort: Over 700,000 childbirths from twelve Latin American and Caribbean countries between 2009 and 2012
finding: Previous maternal morbidity was associated with a higher risk of adverse maternal outcomes, as were the extremes of reproductive ages, nonwhite ethnicity, no stable partner, no prenatal care, smoking, drug and alcohol use, elective C-section, or induction of labour.
mod_finding: Elective C-section and induction of labour were associated with a higher risk of adverse maternal outcomes.
country: Twelve Latin American and Caribbean countries
